summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on July 7, 2026, announcing via press release a continued acceleration in commercial sales of its CyPath Lung diagnostic, with more than 200% year-over-year growth in Q2 2026. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. It discusses revenue growth and physician adoption trends but contains no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event. No terms, deal mechanics, or regulatory milestones are disclosed. This is a simple current report on business progress, with no event that qualifies as a special situation.
